Request number 113488

Request description

In relation to Judges and magistrates, since 2009 when the Constitution was enacted, I request records relating to the following:

(i) how many were complained against

(ii) the names of the persons complained against

(iii) the date of the complaints (iv) how many cases were summarily dismissed

(v) how many cases were investigated in full by the Judicial and Legal Service Commission or otherwise

(vi) the nature of the complaints (theft, perjury, fraud, failure to investigate, failure to discipline other officers, violation of the Public Service Values or Public Service Code of Conduct, respectively sections 4 and 5 of the Public Service Management Act

(vii) what the decision were made by the Governor was

(viii) the date of the decision by the Governor.

In relation to the Attorney General, Director of Public Prosecutions and other legal officers to whom that section applies (for simplicity legal officers):

(i) how many were complained against

(ii) the names of the persons complained against

(iii) the dates of the complaints

(iv) how many cases were summarily dismissed

(v) how many cases were investigated in full by the Judicial and Legal Service Commission or otherwise (vi) the nature of the complaints (theft, perjury, fraud, failure to investigate, failure to discipline other officers, violation of the Public Service Values or Public Service Code of Conduct, respectively sections 4 and 5 of the Public Service Management Act (vii) what decision were made by the Governor was (viii) the date of the decision by the Governor

Closure date

6 June 2025

Outcome type

Exempt s. 23(1) – Unreasonable disclosure of personal information but Granted in part

Outcome reason

Granted in part

Status description

Closed
